user.title: Smart Charging
user.description: Select entities for price data, battery SOC and car control.

data.car_charging_sensor_entity: Car charging state sensor (identity + plug-in edge)
data.charger_mode_sensor_entity: Home charger mode sensor (home + plugged gate)
data.charger_energy_sensor_entity: Charging energy sensor (kWh, optional - for live statistics)

params.title: Charging parameters
params.description: Set battery limits, prices, the weekly 100 % boost and — when the car has regular away-times — the away-window. Tick "Continuous usage" and the away-times plus the daily consumption below are used by the plan; the departure time is the deadline for the charge to be complete.

data.min_soc: Minimum battery level (%), never plan below this
data.max_soc: Maximum battery level (%), normal charging target
data.weekly_full_charge: Charge to 100 % about once a week (cheapest window)
data.usage_enabled: Continuous usage - the car has regular away-times
data.daily_consumption_pct: Daily battery use (%), e.g. the daily commute
data.soc_stale_hours: Use the last known battery level for up to (hours) when the car reports no SOC
data.assumed_soc: Assumed battery level (%) when the SOC is completely unknown

error.usage_required: Both away times must be set
error.usage_same_time: The away times must be different
